points.statement: The framework aims to let groups of language-model agents self-organize to carry out navigation tasks.
points.quote: auto-organize groups of LLM-based agents to complete navigation tasks

points.statement: Organization follows a hierarchy that keeps planning centralized while execution is decentralized across agents.
points.quote: a hierarchical system for multi-agent organization, ensuring centralized planning and decentralized execution

points.statement: An auto-organizing communication mechanism allows groups to adjust dynamically when subtasks change.
points.quote: an auto-organizing and intra-communication mechanism, enabling dynamic group adjustment under subtasks

points.statement: A multimodal information platform supports perception so a single system can handle navigation tasks.
points.quote: a multi-modal information platform, facilitating multi-modal perception to perform the three navigation tasks with one system

points.statement: The system combines centralized planning with decentralized execution to enable navigation in open environments.
points.quote: It utilizes centralized planning with decentralized execution, enabling efficient multi-modal navigation in open-ended environments.
